note: One built-in and compatible-host metadata owner. Defaults are bootstrap hints; model offerings and route/auth behavior retain their existing Rust and live-catalog authorities.

descriptors.label: AICraft
descriptors.guidance: OpenAI-compatible host (Chat Completions + GET /v1/models). Live /v1/models is the model authority: the roster spans DeepSeek, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, GLM, MiniMax and Doubao ids. Store AICRAFT_API_KEY, not a raw key.

descriptors.label: Cheaper Inference
descriptors.guidance: OpenAI-compatible host (Chat Completions + GET /v1/models). Live /v1/models is the model authority: ids are bare, such as gpt-5.4-mini, claude-sonnet-5 and gemini-3.1-pro. Store CHEAPER_INFERENCE_API_KEY, not a raw key.

descriptors.label: Command Code
descriptors.guidance: Published Provider API (OpenAI Chat Completions + GET /v1/models). Do not import the Command Code CLI login. Store COMMAND_CODE_API_KEY, not a raw key.

descriptors.label: Alibaba Model Studio (DashScope)
descriptors.guidance: International Model Studio compatible-mode endpoint (OpenAI Chat Completions + GET /v1/models). Live /v1/models is the model authority: Qwen 3.8 Flash and the dated 0901 release arrive through the catalog, never a hard-coded id. Store DASHSCOPE_API_KEY, not a raw key.

descriptors.label: Runcrate
descriptors.guidance: OpenAI-compatible host (Chat Completions + GET /v1/models, which is public). Model ids are case-sensitive org/Name ids such as deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Live /v1/models is the model authority. Store RUNCRATE_API_KEY, not a raw key.

descriptors.label: Opper
descriptors.guidance: OpenAI-compatible gateway (Chat Completions + GET /v3/compat/models). Bare pool names such as claude-sonnet-4-6 let Opper pick the route; provider/model ids such as anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 pin one route. Live /v3/compat/models is the model authority. Store OPPER_API_KEY, not a raw key.

descriptors.label: Standard Compute
descriptors.guidance: OpenAI-compatible host (Chat Completions + GET /v1/models). The standardcompute model id routes each request across models and providers; vendor-prefixed ids such as deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro pin one model. Live /v1/models is the model authority. Store STANDARDCOMPUTE_API_KEY, not a raw key.

descriptors.label: Tsubasa
descriptors.guidance: OpenAI-compatible host (Chat Completions + GET /v1/models only). Public model ids: tsubasa-pro and tsubasa-fast, both with a 32,768-token context, so set context_window = 32768 on [providers.tsubasa]. Store TSUBASA_API_KEY, not a raw key.

ollama-cloud.guidance: Ollama Cloud requires an API key. Create one in Ollama account settings, then save it for the ollama-cloud provider, set OLLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY for Pi compatibility, or set Ollama's official OLLAMA_API_KEY.

kimi-code.guidance: Create a Kimi Code membership-plan API key in the Kimi Code console. This route uses api.kimi.com/coding/v1; Codewhale does not import Kimi CLI credentials.
